item.title: Bird population inhabiting Mississippi coast removed from endangered species list
item.description: A bird species that inhabits Mississippi’s coastal region is no longer considered endangered. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service announced Monday that it had removed the wood stork from the federal list of endangered and threatened wildlife.
